notes: ABI kitchen sinks (BENCH-15a), from the BIM library downloads: size, the bowls' opening at the rim (undermount cut-out) and, for granite sinks, the body under the flange (top-mount cut-out), all from the spec drawings; models re-oriented from the IFC, rim top at Z = 0. A sink without top_length is undermount only here: ABI prints no body size to cut for. Not verified by a person.
